lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Teresa, it's Rachel. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi! Yes, now's good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How are you doing, really?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So-so. Up and down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, only 1 days. My knees have been bothering me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you try the mall?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What did you notice on the days it went well?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Getting back to work is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Your family is a big part of why.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's real progress.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already bought new sneakers. I didn't think I'd like it, but I do.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Three 10-minute walks count the same as one 30-minute walk.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I put a reminder on the fridge. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I think I can do 20 minutes if it's early. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've picked your days.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it. At least I'm trying.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I walk 15 minutes on 3 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 8. Maybe 9.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 8 and not a 5?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, when I walk I sleep better, I noticed that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: the pain made this week harder, you still got 1 days in, and your plan is to walk 15 minutes on 3 days. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Teresa. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Rachel. Bye!
